desc: Ideate and correct the feasibility formulation: endpoint p mandatory walk length 2n-1-p (or n for p=n-1), deficits covered by edge-pair oscillations with minimum count equal to path MWIS.
Implement the full corrected solution: binary search plus O(n) check using a/b/c weights, prefix/suffix MWIS combination, and brute-force small-case validation.
Verify special cases (p=n-1, n=2, m<n, x=0) and confirm no failing brute-force cases.
